basics.name: Taha Ali
basics.label: Engineer · Researcher · Writer
basics.summary: Academic, researcher, and technology policy consultant working at the intersection of computer networks, information security, emerging technologies, and society.

work.name: National University of Sciences and Technology (NUST)
work.summary: I teach and conduct research at the NUST School of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science (SEECS). I head the Cognet Lab, researching security applications in new and emerging technologies.
highlights: Teach undergraduate and graduate courses in computer programming, computer networks, network security, cryptocurrencies, and blockchain.
Head the Cognet Lab, with research spanning blockchain, machine learning, computer vision, Internet of Things, and information security.
Supervised 25 Masters students and 2 PhD students to graduation.

work.name: National University of Sciences and Technology (NUST)
highlights: Taught in the NUST School of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science (SEECS).
Introduced a Masters-level course on Cryptocurrencies and Blockchain Technology in 2018.
Taught courses including Fundamentals of ICT, Fundamentals of Programming, Computer Networks, Network Routing and Switching, Advanced Computer Networks, and Network Security.

work.name: Newcastle University
highlights: Worked on a flagship EU project on secure and verifiable electronic voting systems.
Contributed to projects on cryptocurrencies and blockchain.
Initiated a project on next-generation botnets.
Contributed to the book Real-World Electronic Voting: Design, Analysis and Deployment.

work.name: University of New South Wales
highlights: Worked on security and green applications of software-defined networks.
Researched data provenance mechanisms for healthcare and IoT devices.

work.name: CSIRO
highlights: Worked on a project to improve the energy efficiency of residential WiFi networks.
Developed algorithms to strategically adjust WiFi access-point modes and transmit power in response to user traffic.
Achieved power savings of up to 40% in experimental deployments.

work.name: WorldCALL Broadband, Pvt. Ltd.
highlights: Worked in engineering and management roles deploying Pakistan's largest hybrid-fiber-coax broadband network.

courses: Security Mechanisms for Body Sensor Networks
highlights: Thesis: Security Mechanisms for Body Sensor Networks
Supervisors: Vijay Sivaraman and Diethelm Ostry.
Research focused on efficient security mechanisms for bodyworn health-monitoring devices.
